playbookOutputs: Copy of the employer's UIF registration confirmation / reference letter from the Department of Employment and Labour
playbookCommonFailures: The company was never registered as an employer — the request comes back 'no record' and the client actually needs UIF Registration
Director ID certification older than 3 months
Request letter not signed by a director or not on the company's letterhead
The UIF record is under a previous trading name or the sole proprietor's name, so the search by CIPC number finds nothing

informationToProvide.label: Certified copy of company registration documents (e.g., CIPC CoR14.3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR14.3 (or CK1/CK2) showing the registered name, enterprise number and directors. Used to prove the requester is entitled to the employer's record.

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID copies of all directors/members
alternatives: Certified passport copy for a foreign director
informationToProvide.aiHint: Certified ID copy for every director on the CoR14.3, certified within the last 3 months. At minimum the director who signs the request letter must be certified.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of business address (utility bill)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Utility bill, lease or municipal account in the company's name dated within 3 months.

informationToProvide.label: Business bank account details
informationToProvide.aiHint: Bank confirmation letter in the company's name, within 3 months. Only needed if the Department asks to verify the employer's banking details against its record.

informationToProvide.label: Details of employees (ID numbers, salaries, start dates)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Employee list (name, ID number, start date, salary). Not needed for a plain copy request, but useful if the Department cannot find the record and needs to match by declared employees.

informationToProvide.label: Existing UIF or PAYE reference number (if known)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Any reference the client has: the U-number, the SARS PAYE number (UIF is usually the same digits with a U prefix) or an old UI-19 declaration. Speeds up the search enormously.

informationToProvide.label: Blank company letterhead
informationToProvide.aiHint: Blank letterhead (PDF, Word or high-resolution image) showing name, registration number and contact details, used to generate the request letter for signature.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect requirements for the UIF copy request
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3, certified director ID, proof of address, letterhead uploaded; any known reference captured
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Chase only what is missing. Explain that the Department will only release an employer's record to a director or a mandated representative, hence the certified ID and signed request. Ask whether the client has ever declared employees or paid UIF via SARS — if not, the record may not exist and the client should be offered UIF Registration instead. Do not promise a shorter turnaround than 30–60 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify identity documents and employer details
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads pass the rules engine or are approved by Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: CoR14.3 and proof of address in the company's name; director names matching certified IDs; certification within 90 days. Extract enterprise number, any PAYE / U-number, trading names and the director who will sign. If a PAYE number is known, note the likely U-number (same digits, U prefix) — ⚠ verify this convention applies to the client's registration.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft request letter and Special POA
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Request letter on client letterhead and POA generated and posted for Kevin's review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Request letter on the client's letterhead addressed to the Unemployment Insurance Fund, Department of Employment and Labour: company name, CIPC number, any known UIF / PAYE reference, physical address, request for a copy of the employer registration confirmation and reference number, and authority for My Accountant (Kevin Freese, CIBA #3561) to receive it. Special POA on My Accountant letterhead. Kevin's signature applied only at approval.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send request letter and POA to client for signature
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed request letter and POA uploaded by client
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the approved drafts with plain instructions: a director signs both, returns as PDF. No deadline threats.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Email copy request to the UIF
fulfillmentChecklist.emailSubjectTemplate: Request for copy of UIF employer registration — {entityName} ({registrationNumber})
fulfillmentChecklist.expectedReply: Department acknowledgement or the registration copy / reference letter
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Attach: signed request letter, POA, CoR14.3, certified director ID, proof of address. ⚠ CONFIRM ADDRESS WITH KEVIN — plan §4.3 marks this channel ⚠; confirm whether the request goes to a UIF employer-services mailbox, the provincial labour centre, or is done through the uFiling profile instead.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for the Department to supply the copy
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Copy of registration / reference letter received, or a 'no record' response
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Follow up quoting the acknowledgement reference and CIPC number. If the Department responds 'no record found', create a proposal for Kevin recommending the UIF Registration service and draft a client message explaining that no registration exists under the company.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver copy of UIF registration to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Registration copy and reference number posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the document and the reference number. Note the monthly UI-19 declaration obligation and offer the payroll / EMP201 service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
